author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೆಳೆವನಖ ಕೂದಲನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಎಸೆವಂತೆ
ತಳೆಯದೇ ನಿಲುವುಗಳ ಗುಣದೋಷಗಳಿಗೆ
ಮೊಳೆಯುವಿಕೆ ಮರುಕಳಿಸೆ ತುಂಡರಿಸಿ ಸತತದಲಿ
ತೊಳೆ ನಿನ್ನ ಪಾಪಗಳ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As you cut and throw away growing nails and hair,
without taking a stand on virtues and faults,
whenever the sprouting returns, cut it away again and again;
wash away your sins, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Faults keep growing back like nails and hair. Without fuss, keep trimming them as they appear, and keep yourself clean.
